pack_constraints: pack a batch of token constraint tensors into a single packed tensor for beam search
unpack_constraints: unpack one row of a packed constraint tensor back into a list of individual constraint tensors
create_constraint_trie: create a ConstraintNode trie from a list of integer token sequences for unordered constraint tracking
advance_unordered_constraint_state: advance an UnorderedConstraintState by consuming a token and returning the next state in the constraint trie
advance_ordered_constraint_state: advance an OrderedConstraintState by consuming a token and returning the next state through linear constraints
